data.narrative:
Pryzm is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $14.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression approach uses the $14M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding $36M. The Peer-Median method examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $700M, derived from a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The divergence between methods reflects the wide dispersion in Defense & Security valuations at early stages.

Triangulating these two approaches yields a valuation range of $30M to $805M, with a median of $368M. The Stage-Progression method anchors the lower bound, while the Peer-Median method dominates the upper bound. The wide range reflects material uncertainty about Pryzm's positioning relative to peers: UFORCE commanded a $1B valuation at Seed stage, while other Series A peers valued substantially lower. Key sensitivities include product differentiation, customer traction, and management team track record relative to the peer set.
